headline.title: NVIDIA, KRAFTON, NC and Reigning ‘League of Legends’ Champions T1 Celebrate RTX Spark at Korea’s PC Bangs
headline.summary: NVIDIA introduced its new superchip, RTX Spark, at GTC Taipei, aimed at enhancing Windows PCs for personal AI applications. Following the announcement, CEO Jensen Huang showcased RTX Spark to South Korea's gaming community, collaborating with developers like KRAFTON and NC, as well as the reigning 'League of Legends' champions, T1.

articles.title: What to expect from WWDC 2026: Siri’s highly anticipated revamp and Apple Intelligence updates
articles.summary: Apple's WWDC 2026 is expected to showcase a significant revamp of Siri, along with updates to Apple Intelligence features. The event will highlight advancements in AI technology and enhancements to user experience across Apple's ecosystem.

articles.title: Five labs, five minds: building a multi-model finance drama on small models
articles.summary: A collaborative project involving five labs is focused on developing a multi-model finance drama using small AI models. The initiative aims to explore diverse perspectives and enhance storytelling in financial contexts through innovative AI applications.

articles.title: The mayor of Shelbyville, Indiana, says only people who live in ‘shitty houses’ oppose data center
articles.summary: Shelbyville, Indiana's mayor, Scott Furgeson, sparked controversy by suggesting that opposition to a proposed $2 billion data center comes primarily from residents living in "shitty houses." The remarks were made in response to the growing number of "No Data Center" signs appearing around the city.

articles.title: Meta made its own AI-generated clickbait news feed
articles.summary: Meta has launched a new AI-generated "For You" section in its standalone Meta AI app, which features a feed of clickbait-style articles created entirely by artificial intelligence. The content includes AI-generated topics, images, and text, raising questions about its reliability and authenticity.

articles.title: OpenAI unveils Lockdown Mode to protect sensitive data from prompt injection attacks
articles.summary: OpenAI has introduced Lockdown Mode for ChatGPT to enhance protection against prompt injection attacks and minimize the risk of sensitive data exposure. While this feature aims to reduce vulnerabilities, experts note that some risk may still remain.

articles.title: Sriram Krishnan is leaving his role as White House AI advisor
articles.summary: Sriram Krishnan is stepping down from his position as White House AI advisor to establish a new institution focused on influencing AI policy under Trump's administration. His departure marks a shift in the White House's approach to artificial intelligence initiatives.

articles.title: The Trump administration might take an equity stake in OpenAI
articles.summary: The Trump administration is exploring potential deals that could involve taking an equity stake in OpenAI, with President Donald Trump stating the aim is to ensure that the American public benefits from advancements in artificial intelligence. Discussions are ongoing regarding the specifics of such arrangements.

articles.title: Crypto-Funded Chinese Peptide Labs Are Booming
articles.summary: Chinese peptide labs are experiencing significant growth due to funding from cryptocurrency sources. In related news, hackers are exploiting Meta's AI bots to compromise Instagram accounts, and Anthropic is providing assistance to NSA hackers.

articles.title: Here comes new Siri again
articles.summary: Apple is set to reintroduce an updated version of Siri at the upcoming WWDC, following a period of lagging behind in AI advancements. The company aims to enhance its virtual assistant's capabilities, signaling a renewed focus on AI technology.
